title: Chapter 412: The Dragon Clan Of The Deserted City
content:
Chapter 412: The Dragon Clan Of The Deserted City

Seeing Wu Shang's gaze, Wu Hui knew that his master still chose to support him.

At this point, Wu Hui no longer cared about anything.

"All the strong people above the supreme realm of the martial family will be taken down!"

"Yes, Lord Lord!"

The strong men from the Human Emperor Palace rushed forward, and the Wu family suddenly became panicked.

They fought desperately while still cried to their ancestors.

"My ancestor, are you watching the Wu family suffer this hardship!"

"Ancestors save us!"

"Ancestor!"

However, Wu Shang seemed to ignore it, but just slowly closed his eyes.

Everyone saw that Wu Shang slowly took off the air, stretched his arms as if he wanted to embrace the whole world.

At the same time, Wu Shang's spiritual sense began to sweep through every corner of the human race.

But at this moment, Wu Shang suddenly opened his eyes and looked in one of them.

There is the direction of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Wu Shang's figure began to dissipate.

He didn't leave anything for the Wu family and his apprentice, but just smiled in that direction.

In the end, Wu Shang left.

The Wu family fell.

.........

On the other side, within the territory of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

The clans of the Chaos Realm were shocked by the powerful aura in the Heavenly Demon Clan.

But they didn't know that the most shocking thing was them!

"What the hell is going on?"

The contemporary leader of the Heavenly Demon Clan asked sternly at the powerful demon clan beside him.

Hearing this, the powerful demon clans around him were all hesitating and unable to explain.

The leader of the Tian Yao Clan was furious.

I still don’t understand such a big thing happened on my territory.

"Check it out, check it out for me now!"

However, as soon as the leader of the Heavenly Demon Clan finished speaking, an old demon clan strongman suddenly said, "Class Chief, that powerful aura is coming here!"

"What!"

At this time, the boundary of the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Ao Qing ordered the dragons to go directly to the Tiande Clan base camp in the name of the Huangcheng.

But I and others chose to go through it slowly.

In Lu Xue's words, it is to observe the real situation of the demon clan as today.

It has to be said that the location at the border of the demon clan today is really desolate, just like the border where the human clan was weak and small back then, deserted and deserted.

On Lu Xue's shoulder, Ao Qing looked back from time to time.

Even after just experiencing the surprise of Long Qun, Bai Ling still followed Lu Xue and others and never left.

Ao Qing wanted to speak but stopped. After a long time, Lu Xue finally sighed.

The two stopped and Lu Xue looked behind her.

Seeing Lu Xue stopping and looking at herself, Bai Ling's nervous heart suddenly became even more nervous.

"Come here."

Lu Xue waved to Bai Ling.

Seeing this, Bai Ling did not hesitate and walked forward nervously.

"senior."

As soon as he arrived in front of Lu Xue, Bai Ling would kneel down directly.

But a gentle force directly dragged her petite body, making her unable to kneel down.

"Kneel when you see someone, are you so cowardly?"

Lu Xue pretended to scold.

Bai Ling lowered his head tightly and did not dare to speak.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue asked that question again.

"Want to follow me?"

This time, Bai Ling seized the opportunity tightly and nodded in her little head.

"I'm willing, thank you senior, thank you senior!"

Seeing this, Lu Xue nodded.

"Bai Ling, right? From now on, Xiaoqing will guide you."

Hearing this, Bai Ling immediately looked at Ao Qing on Lu Xue's shoulder.

Ao Qing yawned and looked at Bai Ling with a smile.

"The little girl looks pretty good, so I will squeeze my shoulders and beat them from now on."

"Um?"

Before Ao Qing could finish his words, Lu Xue glared at Ao Qing.

"Ahem, I mean, I will guide you in the future."

Immediately, Ao Qing flew directly to Bai Ling's shoulder. Even though Ao Qing deliberately restrained his breath, Bai Ling still did not dare to breathe.

"Relax, I won't eat you."

Hearing this, Bai Ling took a deep breath and solemnly looked at Ao Qing, "Senior, please take care of him in the future."

Ao Qing smiled and said, "Don't always call me that seniors. Now we are all the people, so call me Lord Ao Qing in the future."

"Uh, yes, Lord Ao Qing."

Lu Xue walked in front, unable to help but hold her forehead, and didn't know if it was the right choice to hand over Bai Ling to Ao Qing for guidance.

The old man Broken Sword was walking at the end, and his wrinkled old face couldn't help but wrinkle.

At this moment, he had already noticed something was wrong.

It seems that some changes have occurred in the Heavenly Demon Clan.

Bai Ling followed Lu Xue and the future will be smooth sailing. As for her brother, Bai Xu, who awakened the bloodline of the Heavenly Demon, his future will also be bright.

The only difference is that Bai Xu will encounter many difficulties and setbacks on the way, and these will not defeat him, but will make him more tenacious and powerful.

One day in the future, brothers and sisters will meet again.

At the same time, the atmosphere at the Tian Yao Clan Base Camp is extremely depressing.

Dozens of giant dragons covering the sky and the sun enveloped the entire center of the Heavenly Demon Clan, and their might was overwhelming, making the demons frightened.

The same is true for the patriarch of the Tian Yao Clan.

Looking up at these giant dragons, his heart was already overturned.

The most important thing the demon clan pays is bloodline.

And each of these giant dragons has a bloodline far above the current Tiande Clan.

Where did this come from?

"I wonder where you guys come from?"

The head of the Tian Yao tribe stepped forward and asked nervously.

At this time, a giant dragon with the largest size circling in the void spoke, "We are from Huangcheng, and we are ordered by Lord Aoqing to guard the Heavenly Demon Clan."

Lord Ao Qing!

The leader of the Tian Yao Clan was stunned for a moment and looked very happy.

He never thought that Senior Ao Qing was so reliable.

He actually didn't have much hope when he chose to turn to Ao Qing for help.

After all, Ao Qing has been kind to the Heavenly Demon Clan for a long time ago. Today, the leader of the Demon Clan has changed several generations, but who knows whether Ao Qing still buys it or not.

He also learned by chance that Ao Qing was still in the Chaos Realm, so he asked Ao Qing for help with a try-and-seek.

In fact, Ao Qing and Lu Xue had just returned not long ago.

As soon as he heard the request for help from the Tiande Clan, Ao Qing talked to Lu Xue.

So one man and one dragon did not even return to the Human Emperor Palace, but came towards the Heavenly Demon Clan.

"My lords come from afar, we must be treating each other personally!"

Soon, the Heavenly Demon Clan turned danger into joy, and connected the Dragon Clan of the Demon Clan, who had come from afar, into the Heavenly Demon Clan, to fulfill the friendship of the landlord.

.........

"As it really is expanding?"

At the boundary of the Chaos Realm, two figures were standing here and staring at the boundary for a long time.

The man looked very steady and handsome, while on the side was a cute little girl.

"Hey, Xiaojing, are you watching it seriously? You have been watching it for a long time, why don't you say a word?"

After a moment, the man couldn't help asking the little girl beside him.

When the little girl heard this, she sighed slightly and pouted, "Brother Yueming, it's so boring here. When will we go to play with Sister Lu Xue?"
